verdict.rationale: Luma's homepage says its Agents can 'generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text', so the same tool appears to generate audio alongside video. Nothing in the pack documents sound effects, ambient audio, or music, or audio matched to the generated scene; the video-model docs list only visual features. Missing for 10: documented sound-effect, ambient or music generation; scene-matched audio sync; any hands-on or independent corroboration of audio output.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
